tools.name: archive_cancelled_order
tools.description: Deletes a cancelled order from the active orders table and moves its record into the archived orders table. Only orders already marked cancelled are archived.

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the cancelled order to archive

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

DB = "store.db"


@function_tool
def archive_cancelled_order(order_id: int) -> str:
    cn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        cur = cn.cursor()
        row = cur.execute(
            "SELECT id, customer_id, total, status, created_at FROM orders WHERE id = ?",
            (order_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return f"Order {order_id} not found"
        if row[3] != "cancelled":
            return f"Order {order_id} is {row[3]}, not cancelled"
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO archived_orders (id, customer_id, total, status, created_at) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            row,
        )
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO archived_order_items SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?",
            (order_id,),
        )
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?", (order_id,))
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM orders WHERE id = ?", (order_id,))
        cn.commit()
        return f"Order {order_id} archived"
    except Exception as e:
        cn.rollback()
        return f"Failed: {e}"
    finally:
        cn.close()

tools.name: refund_order_payment
tools.description: Issues a refund to the customer's original payment method for an order through Stripe. Refunds the full charge unless a partial amount in cents is given.

params.description: Stripe payment intent ID of the order

params.name: amount_cents
params.description: Amount to refund in cents; omit for a full refund

params.name: reason
params.description: Refund reason: requested_by_customer, duplicate, or fraudulent

tools.name: ship_order_to_warehouse
tools.description: Moves an order from the pending queue to the fulfillment queue and sends the order's shipping details to the warehouse service. Marks the order as sent to the warehouse.

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the paid order to send for fulfillment

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
import requests
from agents import function_tool

DB = "store.db"
WAREHOUSE_URL = os.environ.get("WAREHOUSE_URL", "https://wms.example.com/api/shipments")
WAREHOUSE_KEY = os.environ.get("WAREHOUSE_KEY", "")


@function_tool
def ship_order_to_warehouse(order_id: int, priority: str = "standard") -> str:
    if priority not in ("standard", "express"):
        return "priority must be standard or express"
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB)) as cn:
        with cn:
            row = cn.execute(
                "SELECT o.id, o.status, a.name, a.line1, a.city, a.postal_code, a.country "
                "FROM pending_orders o JOIN addresses a ON a.id = o.shipping_address_id "
                "WHERE o.id = ?",
                (order_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                return f"Order {order_id} is not in the pending queue"
            if row[1] != "paid":
                return f"Order {order_id} is {row[1]}, must be paid"
            items = cn.execute(
                "SELECT sku, quantity FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?",
                (order_id,),
            ).fetchall()
            payload = {
                "order_id": order_id,
                "priority": priority,
                "recipient": {
                    "name": row[2],
                    "line1": row[3],
                    "city": row[4],
                    "postal_code": row[5],
                    "country": row[6],
                },
                "items": [{"sku": s, "qty": q} for s, q in items],
            }
            with requests.Session() as s:
                s.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {WAREHOUSE_KEY}"
                resp = s.post(WAREHOUSE_URL, json=payload, timeout=15)
            if resp.status_code >= 300:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Warehouse rejected order: {resp.status_code}")
            cn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO fulfillment_queue (order_id, priority, status) VALUES (?, ?, 'sent')",
                (order_id, priority),
            )
            cn.execute("DELETE FROM pending_orders WHERE id = ?", (order_id,))
    return f"Order {order_id} moved to fulfillment and sent to warehouse"
